_note: LEG-006 — every component `description` found in the 35 v2 projects under "NodeGX test projects/" on 2026-08-11. Real agent-authored prose, extracted verbatim so the list_components wire-cost measurement is reproducible from the repo rather than from a machine-local corpus.

descriptions.description: A BEN-003 live-drive fixture with NO visual root: inputs feed a counter and the counter's value and change-signal are the component's outputs. Nothing about it can be seen on a canvas — it exists to prove a logic-only component mounts on the bench and reports what it emits.
A BEN-002 fixture for the reset path that has nothing to put back: its input is wired to a Text whose own text parameter is unset, so getPorts derives a type but no default.

Category tile for the browse-by-category section: photo, category name, piece count, one-line blurb and a Browse link whose click is reported through Component Outputs.

Browse-by-category section on the surface band: Ceramics, Coffee and Home from a Static Array, each with its piece count, drawn by CategoryCard through a Repeater in a collapsing Columns. Browse clicks are reported upward.

Featured products section: an announced head and six products from a Static Array (a mix of discounted, best sellers and not-yet-reviewed), drawn by ProductCard through a Repeater in an autoFit Columns grid. Add-to-basket clicks are reported upward.
Dark footer band: wordmark and blurb, Shop / Company / Help link columns, and a copyright line. Every link reports a signal through Component Outputs so the page can say where it would go.

Sticky top menu bar: wordmark, Shop/Ceramics/Coffee/About links, a search field with icon, and a basket button whose count pill reads the app-wide BasketCount variable. Every control reports a signal through Component Outputs.

Split hero for the home page: eyebrow, display headline, supporting line, two calls to action and a large workshop photo, collapsing to one column under 900px. CTA clicks are reported through Component Outputs.
Modal dialog that explains what a clicked control would do — used for search, basket and every stub link. Closes itself with a 'Got it' action and reports closed upward.

Product card for the featured grid: photo with an optional badge pill, name, short description, star rating or a 'No reviews yet' line, price with an optional struck-through compare-at price, and an Add to Basket button reported through Component Outputs.
One reassurance row for the info strip: a lucide icon beside a title and a short line of body text.
Bordered reassurance strip below the hero: free delivery over £40, 30-day returns and secure checkout, three-up in a Columns that collapses under 700px.
A form with name, count, and supplier fields plus an Add button. Creates a new StockItem record on submit.
A single row in the stock list: shows item name, count with +/- buttons, and supplier. Out-of-stock items get a red highlight. Includes delete button.
The main stock cupboard page. Shows sign-in/sign-up when not authenticated. When signed in, shows who is signed in, the stock list, and the add-item form. Queries StockItem from the backend.
